supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: noticeable extension beyond the outer ocular boundaries

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: lighter pixel values in the muzzle area compared to dark periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: thin vertical profile with minimal structural droop

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: faint vertical linear mark or fold visible on the left side of the muzzle (viewer's right)
